description.value:
Requirement You have not Stridden this turn and the target is beyond your first range increment.

Declare a specific effect — disarming, an intimidating near-miss, a shot through a rope or lock, or a called wound the GM allows — then make a ranged Strike at a −1 penalty. On a hit, the effect happens in addition to damage; on a critical hit the effect is doubled or its save is one degree worse, GM's call. Other feats on this page refer to this action by name.

cinderfall.incomplete: bucket 5 by its own text: the on-hit effect is explicitly "the GM allows"/"GM's call," i.e. no clean predicate or fixed number exists to build against. This is also the actual unencoded parent many other cards depend on (below: long-iron-ascendant, dead-center, the-doorway, the-long-reckonings-edge, point-blank-bite, gut-shot, and more) — flagged explicitly since it explains why that whole chain has nothing real to extend. This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP. This card depends on (upgrades, extends, or is gated behind) another Ironsight card in this same package that itself ships rules: [] -- if the parent has nothing real to build on, the child has nothing real to extend either.
